A Two-Stage Method for Acquiring Contradiction Pattern Pair from Web
we propose a two stage method to automatically extract contradiction pairs between typed lexico-syntax patterns, such as Xdrug causes Ydisease and Xdisease caused by Ydrug, from a large web archive.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a two-stage method combining an entailment classifier and a polarity classifier can be used to obtain a large amount of typed contradiction patterns.
